These are component-library boilerplate — NOT real column headers, labels, or data. Do NOT render them as table headers, column names, or visible UI labels. They appear alongside real text in the same section (e.g. a header cell has both realTitle='用户名称' and placeholder='Hillstone Design') — render ONLY the real title, omit the placeholder.
